name: sec-form-d-funding
title: SEC Form D Scraper: Startup Funding Rounds & Private Placements
description: New SEC Form D filings (startup funding rounds, fundraising, Reg D private placements) from EDGAR. Filter by date, state, industry, offering size, new or amended. Returns issuer, CIK, address, phone, amount offered and sold, investors, 506(b)/(c) exemptions, executives. $10 per 1,000 filings.
